agents.howToGetApiKey: How to get an API key
agents.apiKeyEncryptionInfo: API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored in the database. They are decrypted server-side for API requests.
agents.claudeCodeLocalCli: Claude Code uses local CLI (no API key required)
agents.codexLocalCli: Codex CLI uses local CLI (no API key required, authenticate with ChatGPT account)
agents.geminiLocalCli: Gemini CLI uses local CLI (no API key required, authenticate with Google account)
agents.localCliDescription: Claude Code uses the locally installed claude command. No API key is required, but Claude CLI must be properly installed.

globalProviderPreference.title: Default Agent
globalProviderPreference.subtitle: Preferred provider for auto-selection. Used when a role has no individual override.
globalProviderPreference.recheckTitle: Re-probe CLI / API and discard cache
globalProviderPreference.footerNote: Only checks whether the CLI responds (API keys are not checked; 5-minute cache)

skipPermissionToggle.title: Skip agent permission prompts
skipPermissionToggle.onDescription: Launches Claude Code with <code1>--dangerously-skip-permissions</code1> and Codex / Gemini with <code2>--yolo</code2>. Execution never pauses, so be aware it edits files and runs commands immediately.
skipPermissionToggle.offDescription: Surfaces the CLI's standard permission prompt. Safer, but the task pauses each time a question comes up during execution.

memory.pageSubtitle: Visualize the growth of knowledge and learning patterns accumulated by AI agents
memory.emptyHint: Learning growth will appear here once agents complete tasks

recentLearnings.emptyPatternsHint: Trends will accumulate here as agents complete more tasks.
recentLearnings.emptyNodesHint: Knowledge is recorded here as agents learn.

decisionCalibration.title: Plan-gate decision accuracy
decisionCalibration.subtitle: Your approvals/rejections and the auto-approve policy, scored against real task outcomes.
decisionCalibration.empty: No calibrated decisions yet. Data accumulates as plan approvals meet task completions.

pareto.pageSubtitle: Pareto-optimal trade-offs between execution time, success rate and resource cost from past workflow runs, plus goal-driven parameter recommendations
pareto.cpuMemoryNotice: CPU/memory usage is not recorded in the execution log, so the resource axis uses cost per execution (USD) as a proxy.

table.ci: Values are estimate [95% CI low – high]. Success rate uses the Wilson interval; time and cost use a normal approximation.

goal.title: Recommend a parameter set from a business goal
goal.hint: Enter this month's goal to get, for every workflow type × role in the current aggregation, the cheapest model assignment that satisfies it plus a projected monthly impact.

kinds.successRate: Raise success rate to a target

recommendation.title: Recommendations
recommendation.correlationNote: Recommendations are correlational estimates from past runs, not causal effects of a randomised model assignment. Confidence is based on the recommended point's run count (100% at 20 runs).
recommendation.noSegments: No executions match the current aggregation.

reason.already_met: Already met by the current mix

recommendation.insufficientHint: This segment has no reliable candidate (≥ {min} runs).

empty.title: No executions to aggregate
empty.hint: Pareto curves per workflow type × role will appear here once workflow runs accumulate

growth.pageSubtitle: Weekly evidence that the system is getting smarter over time, from workflow transitions and concern history
growth.emptyHint: Weekly series will appear here once tasks complete and concerns are recorded
growth.emptyChart: No data for this period yet
growth.detailsToggle: Show detailed metrics (5 weekly charts and KPIs)

digest.title: This week’s operations digest
digest.subtitle: One index for how smoothly work flowed without human hands or repairs, compared with last week. Not a score of capability or design maturity
digest.indexHint: Mean of the rates with at least 5 samples: autonomous completion, research/plan first-pass, concern recurrence (inverted), knowledge validation, repair rate (inverted). Counts and durations are not folded in
digest.emptyChart: No data for this period yet

retroKpi.sectionSubtitle: Same definitions as the supervisor baseline locked on 2026-08-30 (7-day rolling windows). Badges compare this week with last week: green is better, red is worse
retroKpi.emptyHint: Weekly KPI trends will appear here once workflow transitions are recorded

missSignatures.title: Detection-Miss Signature Review
missSignatures.subtitle: Approve or reject detection cues learned from defects that slipped past the quality gates. Approved cues land in the knowledge base as hints for future research and detector work.

basis.initial_gate: Initial learning period — every suggestion needs human approval until the review record reaches the configured count
basis.insufficient_data: Insufficient data — window samples are below the floor, so no judgement is made (auto-apply stays off)
basis.low_rejection: Rejection rate at or under the threshold — pending suggestions auto-apply
basis.high_rejection: Rejection rate over the threshold — auto-apply stopped, back to approval required

missSignatures.empty: No suggestions are waiting for review. Periods without misses are normal — no detection is expected.
